notes: [P2] construction/scope: drawLanternLight in src/render.js was changed so it falls back to a flat THEME.glowMid fill when createRadialGradient returns nothing usable. This lets the Proxy recording fake in the test run through draw(). Shipping code now branches on a test double, and the fake should provide a gradient stub instead. A real canvas never takes this path, so behaviour does not change, but this edit was not in the brief.

[P2] design: the brief asks for the circle to be drawn 'as a faint outline'. drawRange also fills the disc with THEME.rangeFill (alpha 0.07) and dashes the stroke. The fill is faint and the acceptance criterion only checks the stroke colour and radius, so this is a small departure from the brief's wording, not a miss.

[P1] edge/test gap: for an empty cell, rangePreview depends entirely on canPlace(state, col, row). If canPlace also checks something besides path and occupancy (for example gold or a game-over state), the grass preview disappears at those times, but the brief says it should always show LANTERN.range on empty grass. I could not check this because tower.js is not in the rendered folder. No test covers rangePreview over grass when the player has no gold.

[P1] test gap: the draw test only covers hovering a placed tower. Nothing checks that hovering empty grass draws a ring at cellCenter with radius LANTERN.range, or that hovering a path cell draws no ring.
